opening: I have been noticing unusual writing on the wall.
It lasts less than a minute.
It's not clear, and I can't read it most of the time.
I feel as though I hear strange voices when I see the writing.

opening.text: I've been noticing unusual writing on the wall, which started yesterday. It's not clear and I can't read it most of the time, and each time it happens, it lasts less than a minute. I also feel as though I hear strange voices when I see the writing. I smoke and I use recreational drugs occasionally.
